accepted_scope: Earned Deathknell route through both Suchun payout paths and entry to the owned Tower of Deathknell.

Focused Daosheen first threshold. Four selectable spirits appeared on the dry ledges at 89% boss health. An ordinary-status caster landed a damaging hit on the yellow spirit. The focused check ended before another wave or victory.
known_limits: Direct native hits on the other three spirit colors and later waves were outside the focused test.
One qualifying Inspiration source and the earned-flag tower path were exercised. Other Inspiration sources and the clean level-only entry boundaries lack equivalent native evidence.
Vial delivery to the cursor passed. Same-expedition early Vial replay prevention and a direct post-fix Sullon cursor replacement lacked equivalent native proof.
Development test assistance was used. Some arena geometry and historical combat values were reconstructed.
Internal Tower of Deathknell fights, Harp String acquisition, and Tunare are outside this release.
